title: Hearty High Protein Portuguese Lardons Hash
description: A comforting Portuguese dish featuring crispy lardons and chocolate chips, served on a cedar plank. This high-protein hash is perfect for a sick day or a weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the lardons over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the diced onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onions and garlic, diced potatoes, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the cooked lardons, chocolate chips, and whisked eggs to the bowl with the potatoes and onions, and stir until everything is well combined.
Spoon the mixture onto the soaked cedar planks, dividing it evenly among the four planks.
Bake the hashes in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the hashes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
